description: All 11.4 million buildings (panden) in the Netherlands from the BAG (Basisregistratie Adressen en Gebouwen), the authoritative Dutch national building registry. This is the official BAG GeoPackage 'light' extract from PDOK/Kadaster, containing current buildings only (no version history). Includes building footprints, construction year, lifecycle status, primary usage function (gebruiksdoel), floor area, and number of dwelling units. Native CRS is EPSG:28992 (RD New / Amersfoort). Published monthly by Kadaster via PDOK.

links.title: Browse 3D BAG in this catalog — 3D building models with heights, volumes, and roof types (TU Delft)

table:columns.name: identificatie
table:columns.description: BAG building identifier (16-char pand ID). First 4 digits encode the municipality code (gemeentecode). Unique per building.

table:columns.name: bouwjaar
table:columns.description: Original construction year (oorspronkelijk bouwjaar). Integer year (e.g., 1975). Value of 9999 means unknown. Does not change with renovations.

table:columns.name: status
table:columns.description: Building lifecycle status (pandstatus). Most common: 'Pand in gebruik'. Other values: 'Bouwvergunning verleend', 'Bouw gestart', 'Verbouwing pand', 'Sloopvergunning verleend', 'Pand in gebruik (niet ingemeten)', 'Pand buiten gebruik'.

table:columns.name: gebruiksdoel
table:columns.description: Primary usage function of the building, derived from contained dwelling units (verblijfsobjecten). Values include: 'woonfunctie' (residential), 'industriefunctie' (industrial), 'kantoorfunctie' (office), 'winkelfunctie' (retail), 'logiesfunctie' (lodging), 'bijeenkomstfunctie' (assembly), 'onderwijsfunctie' (education), 'gezondheidszorgfunctie' (healthcare), 'sportfunctie' (sports), 'overige gebruiksfunctie' (other). Can be comma-separated for mixed use. NULL when building has no verblijfsobjecten.

table:columns.name: oppervlakte_min
table:columns.description: Minimum floor area (m²) of contained dwelling units (verblijfsobjecten). NULL when building has no verblijfsobjecten.

table:columns.name: oppervlakte_max
table:columns.description: Maximum floor area (m²) of contained dwelling units. Equals oppervlakte_min when building contains exactly one dwelling unit.

table:columns.name: aantal_verblijfsobjecten
table:columns.description: Number of dwelling units (verblijfsobjecten) in the building. 0 = no addressable units (shed, garage). Higher values = apartment building or mixed-use.

table:columns.name: rdf_seealso
table:columns.description: Linked Data URI for this building in the BAG knowledge graph.

table:columns.name: geom
table:columns.description: Building footprint polygon in EPSG:28992 (RD New / Amersfoort), WKB encoded. Coordinates in meters.

title: Buildings (Panden)

data.title: BAG Buildings (GeoParquet)
data.description: 11.4M building footprint polygons in EPSG:28992 (RD New), GeoParquet 1.1.0 with bbox covering column and Hilbert spatial sorting. 933 MB.

geopackage.title: BAG Buildings (GeoPackage)
geopackage.description: Official BAG GeoPackage from PDOK ATOM download. 7.2 GB. Contains pand, verblijfsobject, nummeraanduiding, openbareruimte, and woonplaats tables.

styles/default.title: Default
styles/default.description: Grey building footprints with blue outlines.

styles/by-age.title: Buildings by Construction Year
styles/by-age.description: Color ramp from dark brown (pre-1800) through orange to pale yellow (post-2000) based on bouwjaar.

styles/by-use.title: Buildings by Use
styles/by-use.description: Categorical colors by gebruiksdoel: red for residential, blue for office/retail, green for healthcare/sports, purple for education.
